description:
About Us

We are a Hong Kong-based technology company specializing in cutting-edge AI engine solutions and AI-powered consumer services. Our clients span across international markets, and we are building a high-performance remote team to accelerate global business growth. We are not looking for just anyone — we are looking for someone exceptional who thinks in numbers, not just in feelings.   



Role: B2B Sales & Business Development Specialist

Location: 100% Remote (Philippines-based)

Salary: PHP 545/hour + performance incentive

Hours: Flexible (Part-time / Side hustle welcomed, minimum 20 hours/week preferred, aligned to HK/global client time zones)   



What You Will Do:   



Conduct outbound prospecting via
, LinkedIn, and video calls to international B2B clients   



Qualify leads and schedule high-value discovery calls / demos for senior stakeholders   



Manage the full sales cycle from first contact through to close   



Maintain accurate pipeline records in CRM (HubSpot or equivalent)   



Track and analyze your own performance data weekly: outreach volume, reply rate, conversion rate, win rate — and adjust your approach based on what the numbers show Identify funnel bottlenecks using data, form clear hypotheses, and run experiments to improve them   



Research target accounts, market trends, and competitor activity   



Support marketing campaigns and business development initiatives   



Our Core Philosophy: Quantitative Before Qualitative

At our company, every business problem is first analyzed with numbers.

? "I feel the campaign isn't working well." — this is NOT analysis.

? "Reply rate dropped from 4.2% to 1.8% week-over-week, likely caused by the subject line change on Tuesday." — this IS analysis.

If you cannot define problems with data, you cannot solve them. We need someone who naturally reaches for numbers when something feels off, and who has actually done this in previous roles — not just heard about it.   



Requirements — Must Have   



Graduate of a recognized university (you MUST include your university and degree in your application)   



Business-level English — written and spoken. You will be assessed during the interview   



Proven, hands-on experience analyzing sales or marketing performance using quantitative metrics — you have personally tracked KPIs, diagnosed problems through numbers, and acted on those insights in a real work setting   



Comfort with spreadsheets (Excel / Google Sheets), funnel metrics (conversion rates, drop-off rates), and basic statistical thinking (averages, ratios, trends)   



Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision   



Strong reporting habits — you proactively flag issues before they become problems   



Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international environment

Outbound sales track record (cold
 / LinkedIn outreach / calling) with measurable results you can quote (e.g., "lifted reply rate from 1.5% to 3.8% over 6 weeks")

Exposure to tech, SaaS, or AI-related industries   



Please Do NOT Apply If:   



You analyze problems primarily through "feelings" or "general impressions" rather than numbers   



You have never personally tracked your own KPIs or pulled data to diagnose a sales/marketing problem in your previous role   



You expect your manager to identify problems for you — we need someone who finds them first, with data   



You cannot provide proof of your university degree when requested   



Your English communication is primarily written-only with limited spoken fluency   



You require constant supervision to complete tasks   



You are looking for a purely task-execution role with no ownership   



If we have to do the analytical thinking for you, hiring you defeats the purpose. Please be honest with yourself before applying.

] with the subject line exactly as written: "AI Sales – [Your Full Name] – [Your University]"

title: Ecommerce Finance Analyst / Fractional CFO for 8 Figure DTC Brand
description:
Summary

Chief Financial Officer (CFO) — Polar Haircare



Location: Remote | Type: Full-time contractor | Compensation: $2,000 per month



About Polar Haircare

We're a fast-scaling direct-to-consumer haircare brand built around one breakout product: Instant Dye Shampoo — a 2-in-1 shampoo and gray-coverage dye that works in 10 minutes and lasts up to six weeks. Our customers are women aged 40–65 who are done with messy, damaging box dye and want something faster and cleaner.



We sell across Shopify (DTC), Amazon FBA, Walmart and TikTok Shop, run meaningful paid media across Meta, Applovin and Google/YouTube, and operate a lean global team with a dual-warehouse (China + US) supply chain and a stack of specialist agencies. We're profitable, growing, and building the business with a potential acquisition in mind.



The Role

This is a hands-on, builder CFO — not a figurehead who manages a finance department. For a business our size, the CFO does the work: builds the models, closes the books with the bookkeeper, reconciles the vendors, runs the payments, and turns raw exports into decisions the founder can act on the same day.



You will own every dollar that flows in and out of Polar Haircare. You'll know exactly where money is coming from and exactly where it's going — and you'll find the leaks before anyone has to ask. Your north star is structural margin: accurate unit economics, ruthless cost control, and reporting that makes the business easier to run and more valuable to sell.



If you think in contribution margin, get uncomfortable when a number can't be traced to source, and enjoy finding the $40k/year nobody noticed was bleeding out — this is your role.





What You'll Own



Daily Close, Reporting & Performance

-Own the daily financial close: prepare consolidated and channel-level P&Ls (Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop), including ad spend from every platform, all revenue streams, and operating expenses.

-Deliver daily performance dashboards covering ROAS, MER, agency fees, indirect expenses, cashback, and the other levers that drive profitability — built for fast decisions.

-Calculate and validate daily COGS on every item sold so margin reporting is always accurate.

-Maintain weekly and monthly P&Ls for leadership with commentary on what moved and why.



Unit Economics & Margin

-Build and maintain landed COGS per unit and fully loaded cost per unit (product, freight, duties, packaging, pick/pack, last-mile).

-Track gross, contribution, and net margin, and present a clean margin waterfall (Revenue ? Gross Profit ? Contribution ? EBITDA ? Net) at every reporting cycle.

-Maintain channel-specific unit economics — especially Amazon (referral fees, FBA fees, storage, PPC) — never blended unless that's the point.

-Set and recalibrate break-even and target ROAS as cost inputs change.



Marketing & Agency Efficiency

-Track total and channel-level ad spend, blended ROAS, MER, CAC, and CAC payback.

-Measure each agency's fees as a % of the revenue or savings they manage and flag any that aren't earning their keep.

-Surface the most and least efficient spend buckets and feed targets back to the media buyers.



Cash Flow, Payments & Working Capital

-Lead cash flow management and working-capital planning to keep operations liquid and funds working efficiently.

-Run end-to-end payment execution for vendors, suppliers, employees, and subscriptions — on time, every time, no penalties or service interruptions.

-Maintain optimal bank balances and manage credit-card funding, top-ups, and utilization.

-Maximize credit-card cashback by tracking agreements and eligibility, and optimize banking/payment platform plans (Airwallex, Wise, etc.) against actual usage.

-Deploy excess cash into short-term treasury options where it makes sense, within agreed risk limits.

-Prepare bi-weekly cash flow reports highlighting inflows/outflows, runway, and key risks.



Vendor & Inventory Control

-Maintain real-time supplier ledgers: PO-wise commitments, payments made, and delivery status.

-Run vendor reconciliations — verify balances, resolve discrepancies, and keep relationships and payables clean.

-Maintain vendor registers and compliance documentation with key suppliers to support smooth operations and audits.

-Perform periodic inventory valuation and flag slow-moving SKUs or overstock.



Expense Governance & OpEx Control

-Categorize every operating cost (payroll/contractors, software, agencies, fulfillment, processing fees, insurance, legal, misc.) and track OpEx as a % of revenue.

-Own a live Subscription Master — every recurring charge, its owner, and its justification.

-Produce periodic deep-dives (salaries, subscriptions, indirect expenses) with 3- and 6-month trend comparisons to surface savings and efficiency opportunities.



Payroll & Bookkeeping Support

-Execute payroll processing — accurate calculations, on-time disbursements.

-Hand the bookkeeper/accountant complete documentation for accurate recording, timely reconciliations, and clean month-end closes (inventory, vendor balances, expense classification).



Exit-Readiness & Strategic Support

Our US accountant prepares the formal diligence/exit document pack. This role keeps the live operating picture that feeds it — so the story the books tell is accurate, current, and defensible.



-Track SDE/EBITDA with clearly documented add-backs, plus trailing-12-month revenue, profit, and growth.

-Monitor revenue concentration, repeat-purchase rate, LTV, and LTV:CAC.

-Proactively flag "hair on the deal" — margin compression, single-supplier risk, revenue volatility, anything a buyer would question — before it surfaces in diligence.

-Turn around ad-hoc, decision-critical analysis on short notice.





What Success Looks Like

-First 30 days: You can trace every line on the P&L to its source. You've found and documented where current reporting understates costs.

-First 90 days: Daily/weekly/monthly reporting runs on a repeatable cadence with minimal manual effort. Accurate per-unit and per-channel economics are live, and break-even/target ROAS are set off real numbers.

-First year: OpEx and agency spend are measurably tighter, cash flow is predictable, and the books are clean enough to drop into a data room without a scramble.





Who You Are

-Proven DTC / e-commerce finance experience — you've owned the numbers for a multi-channel consumer brand (Shopify + Amazon at minimum).

-Fluent in the language of paid-media-driven brands: ROAS, MER, CAC, contribution margin, LTV, blended vs. channel-level economics.

-Genuinely hands-on — you build the models and run the close yourself, not just review someone else's.

-Elite with spreadsheets/financial modeling (Excel/Google Sheets); comfortable pulling and parsing raw exports (CSV/PDF) from Shopify, Amazon, banks, and ad platforms.

-Rigorous about accuracy — you flag uncertainty, never present a shaky number as fact, and reconcile rather than defend.

-Comfortable owning treasury, AP, payroll, and vendor management, not just FP&A.

-Clear, direct communicator — you lead with the headline and the dollar impact, then show the math.



Bonus Points

-Experience preparing a business for sale / acquisition diligence.

-Familiarity with multi-entity structures and cross-border operations/FX.

-Working knowledge of accounting tools (QuickBooks/Xero) and banking platforms (Airwallex, Wise, Revolut).

-Marketplace finance depth (Amazon FBA fee structures, TikTok Shop).



In your application, tell us about a time you found a meaningful cost leak or margin opportunity in a business — what the number was, how you found it, and what changed.



Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Performance Ad Creative & Banner Designer (Full-Time, Long-Term) — Portfolio Required
description:
HOW TO APPLY

  Please begin your application with a link to your portfolio. We want to see the ad

  creatives and banners you have designed, so include Behance, Google Drive, Canva, or

  a PDF. Your work is the most important part of your application, so lead with it.



  ABOUT US

  We are Upcomers, one of the fastest growing prop trading firms in the world. We operate

  in a fast moving, highly competitive market where a single ad creative can d
 whether

  a trader chooses us or scrolls past. Because of that, design sits at the center of our

  growth. We run a high volume of paid advertising across Meta, Google, TikTok, and display,

  and we are looking for a dedicated designer to own that creative output with us for the

  long term.



  We have worked with talented designers from the Philippines before and have always been

  impressed by the level of skill and dedication. That experience is a big part of why we

  are hiring here again.



  THE ROLE

  This is a full time, long term position, not a one time project. We are looking for one

  exceptional designer to grow with us over the coming years. Your core responsibility is

  to produce high performing ad creatives and banners that capture attention, communicate

  trust, and convert traders who are comparing prop firms.



  We are not looking for someone who only executes briefs and waits for the next task. We

  are looking for a creative partner. Someone who is genuinely passionate about advertising

  design, who studies what makes an ad work, and who brings new ideas to the table instead

  of simply repeating what already exists. If you are the kind of designer who sees a weak

  ad and immediately thinks about how you would make it far better, you will fit in well here.



  WHAT YOU WILL DO

  Design scroll stopping static ads, banners, and carousels for Meta, TikTok, Google, and

  display placements. Develop fresh creative concepts and angles, not just variations of

  the same idea. Translate offers, payouts, funding programs, rules, and trader wins into

  clear and persuasive visuals. Produce multiple strong variations of winning concepts for

  testing. Build and maintain a clean template system so we can ship high quality work at

  volume. Review real ad performance with our team and use those insights to improve the

  next round of creative. Help shape the overall creative direction as we scale across

  multiple brands.



  You will have real ownership in this role. Your ideas and your point of view matter, and

  we want a designer who is confident enough to push us to be bolder and more original.



  WHO YOU ARE

  You have a strong portfolio of paid social ad creatives and banners, not brand identity

  or print work. You have real experience designing for
, Instagram, and TikTok

  advertising. You understand hierarchy, contrast, hooks, and mobile first readability, and

  you know the difference between design that simply looks good and design that performs.

  You are genuinely passionate about the craft and enjoy experimenting, innovating, and

  trying new approaches. You can produce several strong creatives consistently without

  losing quality. You communicate clearly in written English, work well independently, and

  take ownership of your work. You have a reliable setup, stable internet, and full time

  availability.



  NICE TO HAVE

  Experience with prop firms, trading, forex, futures, fintech, or financial education is a

  strong plus, although it is not required. We also value experience with motion design,

  short form video, or animated banners, and any examples of ads you have designed that

  measurably improved click through rate, return on ad spend, or cost per result. Above all,

  genuine passion and creative thinking matter more than a perfect checklist of credentials.



  WHAT WE OFFER

  A salary of $1,000 to $1,800 per month depending on skill, along with performance bonuses

  for great work. A stable, long term, full time role with a team that genuinely values

  creativity. Real creative freedom and ownership, where your voice helps shape the work.

  Clear briefs, honest feedback, and access to real campaign data so you can see the impact

  of what you create. Room to grow as we expand across multiple brands.



  HOW TO APPLY

  Begin with your portfolio link. Then tell us, in your own words, what excites you about

  ad design and creative work. Share one or two pieces you are especially proud of and

  explain the thinking behind them. Finally, include your monthly salary expectation, your

  timezone, and your available working hours.



  Shortlisted designers will be invited to complete a small paid test project, so you have

  the chance to show your skills on a real brief. We look forward to seeing your work and

  getting to know how you think.

title: Marketing / Kundenbetreuung / Projektmanagement
description:
Deutschsprachige Online Marketing Specialist / Marketing Assistant gesucht

Vollzeit | 100% Remote

Wir suchen eine zuverlässige und motivierte Person, die unser Team bei der Umsetzung von Online-Marketing-Projekten unterstützt. Der Fokus liegt auf praktischer Marketingarbeit: Kampagnen vorbereiten, schalten und optimieren, Landingpages erstellen, Werbeanzeigen umsetzen, Texte schreiben und Kundenprojekte eigenständig abarbeiten.



Diese Position ist ideal für jemanden, der sehr gut Deutsch spricht, gerne strukturiert arbeitet und sich im Bereich Online-Marketing weiterentwickeln möchte.



Da unsere Projekte für den deutschsprachigen Markt umgesetzt werden, sind ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse zwingend erforderlich.



Du solltest entweder:



Deutsch als Muttersprache sprechen, oder Deutsch auf nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau sprechen und schreiben können.

Sehr gute Rechtschreibung, Grammatik und ein natürliches Sprachgefühl auf Deutsch sind für diese Position besonders wichtig.



Deine Aufgaben



Du unterstützt uns bei der Umsetzung von Online-Marketing-Projekten für Kunden aus dem deutschsprachigen Raum. Das Ziel dieser Projekte ist meistens, mit bezahlten Werbekampagnen entweder Bewerbungen für Unternehmen zu generieren oder Leads für neue Kundenanfragen zu gewinnen.



Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem:



- Erstellung und Bearbeitung von Landingpages

- Vorbereitung und Umsetzung von Werbekampagnen auf Meta, Google oder LinkedIn

- Erstellung von Anzeigenbildern und einfachen Creatives mit Canva

- Verfassen von Werbetexten, Anzeigen, Headlines und Landingpage-Texten auf Deutsch

- Nutzung von KI-Tools zur Unterstützung bei Texten, Ideen und Kampagnenvorbereitung

- Eigenständige Abarbeitung von Kundenprojekten nach klaren Vorgaben

- Recherche von Zielgruppen, Angeboten und Wettbewerbern

- Pflege und Aktualisierung von Kampagnenunterlagen

- Unterstützung bei der Optimierung laufender Kampagnen

- Kontrolle von Landingpages, Anzeigen und Texten auf Qualität und Vollständigkeit

- Zusammenarbeit mit unserem internen Team über Online-Tools



Der direkte Kundenkontakt ist nicht der Hauptfokus dieser Position. Trotzdem solltest du professionell auf Deutsch per E-Mail und bei Bedarf auch per Online-Call mit Kunden kommunizieren können, um Marketingkampagnen abzustimmen, Rückfragen zu klären und Projekte zuverlässig voranzubringen.



Das solltest du mitbringen

- Sehr gute bis perfekte Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

- Vollzeit-Verfügbarkeit (zumindest 30 Stunden/Woche)

- Sehr zuverlässige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

- Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse im Bereich Online-Marketing

- Grundkenntnisse in Meta Ads, Google Ads oder LinkedIn Ads

- Erfahrung mit Canva oder ähnlichen Design-Tools 

- Erfahrung mit Landingpages, Funnels oder Website-Buildern

- Gute Computerkenntnisse und sicherer Umgang mit Online-Tools

- Fähigkeit, klare Vorgaben selbstständig umzusetzen

- Interesse an KI-Tools wie ChatGPT zur Unterstützung bei Marketingaufgaben

- Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Lernbereitschaft

- Stabile Internetverbindung und ruhiger Arbeitsplatz im Homeoffice

- Freude daran, Kampagnen, Texte und Marketingmaterialien praktisch umzusetzen



Was wir dir bieten

- 100% Remote-Arbeit

- Vollzeitstelle mit langfristiger Perspektive

- Arbeit für spannende Marketingprojekte im deutschsprachigen Markt

- Klare Aufgaben, Prozesse und Anleitungen

- Einarbeitung und laufende Weiterbildung im Bereich Online-Marketing

- Möglichkeit, praktische Erfahrung mit Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Landingpages, KI-Tools und Performance Marketing zu sammeln

- Zusammenarbeit mit einem professionellen und unterstützenden Team

- Entwicklungsmöglichkeit zum Online-Marketing-Profi



Es handelt sich um eine Vollzeitstelle. Da wir mit Kunden und Teammitgliedern im deutschsprachigen Raum arbeiten, sollte eine teilweise Überschneidung mit europäischen Arbeitszeiten möglich sein.



Bezahlung



Die Bezahlung richtet sich nach Erfahrung, Qualifikation und Deutschkenntnissen. Bitte gib in deiner Bewerbung deine Gehaltsvorstellung sowie deine bisherige Erfahrung im Online-Marketing an.



Bewerbung



Bitte bewirb dich mit folgenden Informationen:



- Kurze Vorstellung deiner Person

- Beschreibung deiner Deutschkenntnisse

- Information, ob du in Deutschland, Österreich oder der Schweiz gelebt hast

- Deine bisherige Erfahrung im Online-Marketing

- Erfahrung mit Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Canva oder Landingpages

- Beispiele deiner bisherigen Arbeit, falls vorhanden

- Deine gewünschte monatliche Vergütung

- Deine Verfügbarkeit und mögliche Arbeitszeiten



Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Bookkeeper & Administration Officer

This is a combined bookkeeping and administration role for someone with genuine depth in both areas. You will take full ownership of the financial function and run the day-to-day administrative engine of the business along with one of the directors, not as separate jobs but as one coherent responsibility.



The duties and responsibilities are as follows:



Financial Management

1. Full-cycle bookkeeping in Xero: invoicing, bank reconciliation, accounts payable and receivable, and payroll support

2. Independent preparation and lodgement of Business Activity Statements (BAS) in compliance with ATO requirements

3. Cash flow monitoring with proactive escalation to leadership where needed

4. Ongoing maintenance of financial records to a standard that holds up under scrutiny

5. Direct liaison with the external accountant and relevant advisors on financial matters

Administration and Operations

8. Stakeholder coordination across internal teams and external partners, with consistent follow-through

9. Oversight of digital and physical filing systems and document governance

10. Supplier management, procurement support, and onboarding administration

11. Identification and implementation of process 



The right candidate has been around long enough to know the difference between being busy and being effective. You have run a books function without someone checking your work, lodged BAS on your own initiative, and kept an office running while everyone else was focused elsewhere. Specifically, you bring:



– 4 to 5 years of bookkeeping experience ideally or at minimum, with advanced working knowledge of Xero

– A track record of independently lodging BAS on time and accurately

– Substantial administration experience where you held real accountability, not just a supporting role

– Native or near-native written and spoken English, with strong professional communication skills

title: Remote AI Video Artist (Kling + Nano Banana) for Kids' Music Video Series
description:
About Me / About the Role



I'm Michael, filmmaker and founder of Nice Films in South Tyrol, Italy. Alongside my client work, I produce a recurring kids' music video series for YouTube — a 2D hand-drawn cartoon style with anthropomorphic vehicles and animal characters, made for kids aged 3–7.



I'm looking for a skilled remote AI video artist and editor to produce these videos end to end. I lead the creative side: I send you the story, the song (in English and German), a rough structure with the scenes I have in mind, character reference sheets and other assets. Your job is to generate the keyframes and animations with AI tools and then edit the complete ~3–4 minute music video in DaVinci Resolve — keeping the characters perfectly consistent throughout.



This is not a one-off gig: I'm looking for someone to make these videos for us on a long-term, ongoing basis.



Our Channels (see what we've made so far)



You can watch the videos we've produced so far here:



- German channel: 

- English channel: 



Responsibilities



- Generate the keyframes in Nano Banana based on the story, scene briefs and character reference sheets I provide. This is what we currently use and it works best for us — a different image model is fine as long as the quality is right.

- Animate the shots in Kling (2.6 or Omni) from the keyframes, following the camera and motion direction. Kling currently gives us the best results for this type of video.

- Keep the characters 100% on-model and consistent across all frames and shots

- Use the assets I provide (story, song, scene structure, character reference sheets).

- Edit the complete music video in DaVinci Resolve from the rough structure and scenes I send you. Videos are about 3–4 minutes long.

- Cut the edit to the song. The song exists in English and German — you can edit to either version, the content is the same.

- Send the finished DaVinci Resolve project back to us, together with all generated keyframes and animations.



Requirements



- Hands-on experience generating images with Nano Banana (Gemini) or a comparable AI image model with strong, consistent quality.

- Hands-on experience animating with Kling (2.6 or Omni), or a very strong equivalent for this cartoon style.

- Solid editing skills in DaVinci Resolve: cutting to music, pacing, rhythm and clean, well-organized timelines.

- Strong eye for character consistency and detail — spotting and fixing deformations, extra limbs and design drift.

- Reliable, independent worker with clear communication. English is enough.

- We currently need about 4 videos per month. This may increase in the future.

- From our experience, one video is doable in about 6 hours, so you should not need more than 8 hours per video.

- Our proposal: $6/hour plus $52 for the AI credits per video — so about $100 per video.



How to Apply



Please reply with:

- Your best AI video example that you made yourself (generation + edit), ideally character-based and consistent across multiple shots.

- A short description of your workflow: which AI tools you use for images and animation, and how you edit.

-  We'd prefer to agree on a fixed price per video. We pay you for 8 hours per video — no matter how long you actually need — plus $50 for the AI credits. (From our experience that's more than enough; we generally need quite a bit fewer credits.)



Home Assignment (Test)



You'll receive a short briefing with all assets and scene descriptions.



Your task: produce the first 30 seconds of the song as a finished video. Send me the video, the DaVinci Resolve project, and all keyframes and animations you created, so that I can open the project too.



This test assignment is unpaid.

title: AI Video Editor - $25/hr
description:
Hiring: AI Content Operator — $15–25/hr, remote, contractor



The setup



.



I've already got an audience and a funnel running — YouTube and Instagram content that turns into free-course signups and 30-day GoHighLevel trials. (Some of us have started calling this "Claude for Content" — you'd be the one actually running it day to day to get things made and out the door.) The ideation and the content pipeline are mine — I'm deeply involved in that part, every week. What I need is someone to take it from there: build the automations, generate the actual content with AI, get it edited, and get it posted, on time, without me having to chase it.



.



The role at the simplest level



You're doing three things every single day. Taking the ideas and scripts that come out of our content pipeline and actually producing them — AI-generated, B-roll, whatever the format calls for. Getting each piece edited, mostly through AI tools, and out the door on schedule, whether that's an automated post or you hitting publish yourself. And repurposing what's already live into the next thing — same content, new platform, new cut.



.



Why I'm hiring



That's the floor. The reason I'm posting this is I'm not handing off ideation — that part's staying with me and the pipeline I've already built. What I want is someone who can take a script and a hook and actually turn it into a finished, edited, posted, and repurposed piece of content without needing their hand held through it. Execution brain, every day. We'll still go through the analytics together — but production can't bottleneck on me.



.



Who we are



I'm Vico Khang. I build and run AI automation and no-code agency systems on GoHighLevel — AI voice and chat agents, lead-gen automations, white-label SaaS — on real client accounts, not just talking about it on camera. The content side grew out of that: people kept asking how I was doing it, so I started filming it, and that turned into a real audience on Instagram and YouTube. We're not a media company that picked up automation as a topic. We're an automation business that happens to also make good content about it. Want the longer version, in my own words? Watch it here: 



.



How to apply Fill out the doc here: 



.



Day to day



Building and maintaining the automations that move content from script to published post, cutting out manual busywork wherever it can. Generating the actual content with AI tools once a script or idea comes down the pipeline — B-roll voiceover pieces, AI-avatar or UGC-style videos, whatever the format calls for. Editing through AI tools first, and stepping in by hand only where AI can't get it there. Posting on schedule, automated where it makes sense, manual where it doesn't. Repurposing everything that goes out on YouTube or Instagram into TikTok, LinkedIn, and
 versions. Flagging anything in the calendar that needs a second look, and looping me in on the numbers — we go through those together.



.



What I need



Real, hands-on fluency with Claude and the broader AI content stack — Gemini, Higgsfield, HeyGen — enough to take a script or idea and actually produce a finished piece with it.



Comfortable building simple automations — Zapier, Make, n8n, or native tool workflows — so posting and repurposing don't need a human clicking every button.



Solid editing instincts, and just as important, knowing which AI tool can do the edit for you and when it can't.



Real, hands-on posting experience on YouTube and Instagram — you know the upload mechanics, scheduling, and formatting quirks of each platform cold.



Comfortable repurposing long-form into short-form without needing a brief for every single cut.



Decent English. We're filming for a US, UK, Canada, and Australia audience.



.



Bonus



If you've actually run the production and distribution side of a channel — your own or someone else's — and know what breaks when you try to automate posting and repurposing, that's a big plus.



.



What won't work



Someone who wants to own the ideation and strategy — that's staying with me and the content pipeline. Someone who treats AI tools as optional instead of the default way things get edited and produced. And someone who needs a fresh brief for every single piece instead of running the system once it's handed to them.



.



How to apply Fill out the doc here: 



Please don't send me a generic resume with nothing to show how you actually produce content with AI — I'll know within 5 seconds, and I'll just close it.

title: Cracked Internet-Native Video Editor
description:
Full-time, 40 hours/week, fully remote

Work during the day in your local time

Competitive compensation based on skill, taste, and creative instinct.



> Brief Company Overview 

Willo is an AI business builder that helps people turn ideas into real businesses without needing technical skills, a full team, or months of setup. Now we’re looking for someone to help us tell that story through video.



> Hiring Goal 

We’re not looking for someone to just execute edits from a checklist. We want someone we’d eventually trust to run with the brand creatively. Someone who can help shape the voice, pacing, energy, and internet presence of Willo across platforms.



This role is NOT a fit if you only want to clock in, edit assigned clips, and clock out. We’re looking for someone who gets excited about ideas, internet culture, startups, storytelling, and building a brand people obsess over.



We’re hiring a full-time video editor who doesn’t just “edit videos,” but actually understands what makes people stop scrolling, keep watching, and care.



We want someone who lives and breathes video trends. Someone who knows what’s working on social media platforms. Someone who has strong opinions, creative instincts, and the confidence to try different formats without waiting to be spoon-fed every instruction.



You don’t need to have 10 years of experience. But you do need to show that you already care deeply about video, storytelling, pacing, hooks, retention, trends, 
s, formats, and internet culture.



We care deeply about internet taste. Knowing what feels fresh, sharp, emotionally compelling, and culturally relevant. Versus what feels outdated, corporate, or overproduced. We value speed and iteration over perfection. We’d rather test 10 strong ideas quickly than spend two weeks polishing one video.



> Responsibilities 

We want to be completely transparent about everything you might handle. Don't let this list scare you off. You do not need to be a master of all of these on day one, but you should be excited to dive into them:



• Long-Form Video Editing: Own the end-to-end editing process for long-form content like interviews, podcasts, and deep-dive videos, keeping the pacing tight and engaging throughout. 

• Long-to-Short Repurposing: Take long-form videos and extract the absolute best hooks and insights to create high-impact short clips.

• Content Revival: Breathe new life into older, archived videos, spinning them up so they feel fresh, relevant, and brand new.

• Format Experimentation: Test multiple video styles, pacing, visual effects, and storytelling formats to see what resonates best with our audience.

• Platform Tailoring: Adapt video assets specifically for the unique cultures of Tech
,
, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other platforms.

• Creative Ownership: Pitch your own concepts, tell us what trends we should jump on, and confidently express your opinions on our content direction.

• Asset Management: Organize raw footage, project files, and finished assets so our media library stays clean and accessible.



> The vibe we are looking for

You might be early in your video editing career, and that is completely fine with us. We do not care about years of corporate experience. We care about talent, drive, and taste.



• Trend Native: You understand GenZ internet culture, current vide/audio trends, and changing algorithms.

• Context King/Queen: You have a sharp ear for dialogue and know exactly where to cut a clip so it retains its full context and punch.

• Free Thinker: You do not wait around for instructions. You bring your own creative vision to the table and take pride in your work.

• Portfolio Ready: You have a collection of work (even personal projects or spec ads) that proves you can edit engaging content.

• Huge plus if: You already spend time on Tech
, LinkedIn, and TikTok, so you understand the specific audience we are talking to.

• Builder Mentality: You genuinely want to help build something big. You think beyond individual edits and care about audience growth, brand perception, 
ntum, and impact.

• Internet Taste: We care deeply about internet taste. Knowing what feels fresh, sharp, emotionally compelling, and culturally relevant. Versus what feels outdated, corporate, or overproduced.



Honestly, we’re looking for the cracked internet-native editor who’s already obsessing over hooks, pacing, retention, storytelling, and why certain content explodes online.



> How to Apply

Submit your details through this Google Form: 

Don't just send a generic resume. Send us your portfolio, show us what you've built.

title: Full-Time Video Editor & Social Media Manager
description:
**APPLICATIONS WON’T BE CONSIDERED UNLESS YOU DO THE TRIAL TASK MENTIONED BELOW. DEADLINE IS SUNDAY NIGHT**



We’re looking for a hard working, creative, and highly capable Content & Social Media Manager to take ownership of our organic content across all platforms.



This is not a basic VA role.



We need someone who is genuinely skilled at social media, understands what makes content perform, and can turn raw footage into engaging videos that feel native to TikTok, Instagram,
, and YouTube Shorts.



You’ll be working closely with Mikaela, the founder of The Undiet Company, a fast-growing business that helps women stop binge eating and heal their relationship with food.



Your Role

You’ll be responsible for managing the organic content side of the business from start to finish.



This includes:

• Editing short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, and YouTube Shorts

• Creating strong hooks, captions, subtitles, and on-screen text

• Planning weekly content based on our brand, offers, audience, and goals

• Repurposing long-form content into short-form clips

• Posting and scheduling content across platforms

• Tracking what content performs best and suggesting improvements

• Helping come up with new content ideas, trends, angles, and formats

• Keeping our content organised and making sure everything is posted on time

• Understanding our audience and creating content that speaks directly to women struggling with binge eating, overeating, food guilt, and dieting



You Must Be Good At

• Short-form video editing

• Social media content strategy

• Writing strong hooks and captions

• Understanding TikTok, Instagram,
, and YouTube Shorts

• Spotting trends without making the brand feel cringe

• Taking initiative without needing every tiny step explained

• Working quickly while still producing high-quality content

• Staying organised and meeting deadlines



Requirements

• Full-time availability

• Strong English communication skills

• Proven experience managing and editing social media content

• Experience with tools like CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, Canva, Metricool, Later, or similar

• Reliable internet and ability to work independently



Application Task

To apply for this role, you must complete a short video editing task! Your application will NOT be considered unless you do this.



We’ve provided a Google Drive folder with raw footage. The raw footage is only around 2 minutes long.



You can access it here: 



Your task is to turn the raw footage into a short-form video/Reel that feels engaging, polished, and native to Instagram/TikTok.



You’re free to edit in your own style, but to give you some inspiration, we like the editing on this kind of video: 



We’ll be looking at:

• Your editing style

• How well you create a strong hook

• Pacing and flow

• Captions/on-screen text

• How well the final video holds attention

• Whether it feels suitable for our brand and audience



You can send the finished video as a Google Drive link, Dropbox link, or downloadable file. Deadline for video submissions is Sunday night (21st), as we will be reviewing all applications on Monday.



To Apply

Please send:

1. A short intro about yourself

2. Your completed video editing task

3. Examples of other short-form videos you’ve edited and any social media accounts you’ve helped manage in the past

4. The tools you use for editing and scheduling

5. Your expected monthly salary in PHP

6. Why you think you’d be a good fit for this role

title: Amazon Account / Brand Operations Manager (Private Label)
description:
Are you a strategic, data-driven Amazon operator with a passion for optimization and brand growth?

We are a fast-growing Amazon private label brand seeking a full-time Amazon Account / Brand Operations Manager to oversee our listing performance, conversion optimization, and brand presence on Amazon.



You’ll play a key leadership role in improving conversion rates, maintaining a strong brand identity, and driving account health through data-backed decisions. This is a long-term opportunity with growth potential in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.



Key Responsibilities

Accountability & Ownership

Own and optimize Amazon listings for maximum visibility and conversions

Manage brand positioning, messaging, and consistency across listings, A+ content, and storefront

Implement CRO strategies and coordinate ongoing A/B tests

Coordinate freelancers and vendors (designers, photographers, copywriters, content creators)

Monitor and improve brand health metrics: rankings, reviews, CTR, CR, Buy Box, etc.

Ensure Amazon account hygiene: compliance, suppressed listings, variations, flat files (as needed), category attributes, and policy adherence



Daily & Weekly Tasks

Perform ongoing listing audits and implement improvements (titles, bullets, images, backend, A+, attributes)

Analyze competitors for positioning and conversion opportunities (without product scouting)

Track performance: sessions, conversion rate, CTR, sales rank, review velocity, return rate

Collaborate with PPC, supply chain, and creative teams to align:

Listing updates with ad strategy

Inventory levels with promo and demand forecasts

Creative needs with conversion goals

Manage reporting and ensure action items are executed consistently



Long-Term Projects & Goals

Build a consistent, strategic brand identity across all customer touchpoints on Amazon

Create a repeatable system for ongoing listing improvement and CRO

Improve customer loyalty and retention through stronger messaging, brand voice, and content

Develop SOPs for listing updates, creative briefs, review management, and performance reporting



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

KPI 1: Listing Quality & Organic Performance

Objective: Improve listing visibility and discoverability through optimization



Metrics:

Keyword indexing coverage + organic rank improvements

CTR improvements (Search + ads-supported)

Reduction in suppressed/invalid attributes and listing issues

Actions:

Run keyword research and update listings using Helium 10 + market analysis

Maintain listing audit checklist and optimization tracker

Monitor indexing, rank trends, and category attribute completeness



KPI 2: Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

Objective: Improve conversion rate through data-backed iteration

Metric: Conversion Rate (%) from Amazon Business Reports

Actions:

Optimize copy, images, A+ content, and brand story

Run split tests where possible (ManageByStats, Splitly, Experiments, or equivalent)

Monitor behavior signals (CTR, CVR, returns, reviews) and iterate



KPI 3: Brand Health & Customer Trust

Objective: Improve brand reputation and customer experience

Metrics:

Review rating + review velocity

Return rate trends and top return reasons

Q&A hygiene and listing clarity improvements

Actions:

Review monitoring + recurring issue reporting

Coordinate content updates to address objections/returns

Strengthen product education via visuals + A+ modules

Qualifications & Skills



Required

3+ years managing private label brands on Amazon (account management / listing optimization

Deep understanding of Amazon SEO and algorithm fundamentals

Strong experience with Helium 10, keyword research, and listing optimization

Proven ability to brief and coordinate creatives (designers, copywriters, photographers)

Familiarity with A+ content, storefront management, and conversion tracking

Strong operational discipline: can manage tasks, trackers, and deadlines without hand-holding



Preferred

Background in marketing, branding, or e-commerce growth strategy

Experience with CRO/testing platforms (e.g., ManageByStats, Splitly, Amazon Experiments)

Experience using Asana, Notion, or Trello for project management

Understanding of PPC’s relationship to CTR/CVR and organic rank (coordination-level, not necessarily hands-on media buying)



Soft Skills

Ownership mentality and high attention to detail

Strong marketing instincts and customer-centric thinking

Excellent written and verbal English communication

Organized, proactive, and reliable

Analytical mindset — able to turn data into decisions



What We Offer

Competitive rates

Fully remote

Bi-weekly payments and performance reviews

Long-term role with growth potential

Paid leave and additional benefits after 6 months (SSS, Pag-ibig, health insurance)

Supportive team culture with room for innovation and contribution

Training resources and personal development opportunities



How to Apply

Include in subject line: “[Your Favorite Book] - Amazon Account / Brand Manager Application”

Attach your updated resume

Include a short video (2–3 min) introducing yourself and describing your:

Experience optimizing Amazon listings and improving conversion rates

Tools you’ve used and how you used them

A specific listing improvement you made and the result (CTR/CVR/rank/reviews)

Complete the internet speed test from speedtest.net and attach a screenshot

Attach a screenshot with your computer specs



Why Join Us?

This is more than just account management. It’s an opportunity to take ownership of Amazon performance, strengthen a real brand, and build systems that scale. If you’re driven by impact, autonomy, and measurable outcomes, we’d love to meet you.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
I'm the founder of a digital growth marketing company that helps mission-driven founders scale their businesses with more ease & less overwhelm - and I'm looking for a small team of highly-skilled Executive Assistants to help take over the marketing and management tasks that make a huge difference in the lives of the people that hire us.



I'm looking for a max of 5 amazing executive assistants available for part-time (potential for full time) with a salary starting at $500 USD per month and with long term success and robust training, moving up to $700 USD per month as an emerging leader in the company.



If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply:



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar &
 Management, etc)

You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to
 & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language



- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify

You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software



- 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram,
, Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing

You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus



- Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)

You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-)



- Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and
 service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc)



ABOUT YOU:

- “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable.

- Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects.

- You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months.

- You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth

- You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving.

- Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday.

- You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources.

- You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for.



If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply.



PERKS:

I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in:

- Task & Calendar Management

- Launch/Sales Strategy Planning

- Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses)

- Social Media Management

- Digital Media Marketing (Including
 and SMS Marketing)

- Lead Generation



After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include:

- Part time work hours

- Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast)

- Starting Salary at $500 USD a month ($6000 USD annual)

- Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn)



Interested? Please reply to this post with the secret keyword "APPLES" so I know you can pay attention to detail - from there, I'll let you know next steps if you qualify.

title: Healthcare Compliance & Regulatory Advisor
description:
About the Opportunity



We are seeking an experienced healthcare compliance, regulatory, legal, ethics, privacy, or risk management professional to support multinational organizations operating throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.



This role offers the opportunity to work directly with executive leadership teams and senior advisors on complex compliance, governance, regulatory, privacy, anti-corruption, and risk management matters affecting multiple jurisdictions.



Particular emphasis will be placed on supporting organizations operating within the medical device, healthcare, pharmaceutical, life sciences, and other highly regulated industries.



The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor supporting the development, implementation, enhancement, and ongoing operation of sophisticated compliance programs, regulatory initiatives, investigations, governance activities, and operational compliance functions throughout the EMEA region.



Key Responsibilities



Compliance Program Leadership & Governance



* Support the design, implementation, enhancement, and maintenance of enterprise compliance and ethics programs.

* Assist organizations with developing scalable compliance infrastructures, governance frameworks, reporting mechanisms, and oversight processes.

* Support compliance committee activities, executive reporting, risk management initiatives, and program effectiveness evaluations.

* Provide strategic and practical compliance guidance to executive leadership teams.

* Assist organizations in fostering a culture of ethics, compliance, accountability, and regulatory excellence.



Regulatory & Compliance Advisory



* Conduct legal, regulatory, and compliance research across EMEA jurisdictions.

* Monitor regulatory developments, enforcement trends, industry standards, and emerging compliance risks.

* Prepare executive-level memoranda, reports, risk assessments, and compliance guidance.

* Analyze regulatory obligations and provide recommendations regarding implementation priorities and risk mitigation strategies.



Healthcare, Commercial & Third-Party Compliance



* Support reviews involving healthcare professional interactions, educational programs, sponsorships, grants, consultant engagements, speaker programs, and related activities.

* Assist with anti-bribery, anti-corruption, ethics, and third-party risk management initiatives.

* Support distributor, vendor, consultant, and business partner due diligence reviews.

* Assist with commercialization governance, promotional activities, and operational compliance matters.

* Provide guidance regarding MedTech Europe, EFPIA, ABPI, and other applicable industry expectations and best practices.



Policies, Procedures & Training



* Draft, review, and maintain policies, procedures, codes of conduct, governance frameworks, standards, and guidance documents.

* Develop compliance training materials, communications, awareness initiatives, and educational programs.

* Support organization-wide compliance and ethics training initiatives involving anti-corruption, privacy, investigations, healthcare compliance, and related risk areas.

* Assist with policy implementation and operationalization efforts across multiple jurisdictions.



Investigations, Monitoring & Risk Assessments



* Conduct or support workplace investigations, compliance investigations, ethics matters, and issue management activities.

* Assist with witness interviews, documentation reviews, findings reports, and remediation planning.

* Conduct compliance risk assessments, monitoring activities, internal reviews, and gap analyses.

* Support development of risk-based auditing and monitoring programs designed to evaluate compliance program effectiveness.



Privacy, Data Protection & Regulatory Affairs



* Support privacy and data protection initiatives throughout the EMEA region.

* Assist with GDPR compliance, international data transfers, vendor oversight, and privacy governance activities.

* Support organizations in preparing for regulatory inquiries, audits, inspections, and examinations.

* Interface with regulators, government agencies, notified bodies, accrediting organizations, and external stakeholders as needed.

* Coordinate with local counsel and subject matter experts regarding jurisdiction-specific legal and regulatory matters.



Preferred Qualifications



* Attorney, compliance professional, regulatory affairs professional, privacy professional, risk management professional, or related discipline.

* Minimum five years of relevant experience.

* Experience supporting multinational organizations operating across multiple EMEA jurisdictions.

* Strong analytical, research, writing, communication, and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent verbal and written English proficiency.

* Demonstrated ability to work independently while effectively supporting executive leadership teams.

* Experience within healthcare, medical device, pharmaceutical, life sciences, financial services, or other regulated industries strongly preferred.



Location



Candidates located in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Germany, France, Netherlands, Belgium, Switzerland, Spain, Italy, Sweden, Denmark, Poland, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, or other EMEA jurisdictions are encouraged to apply.



Application Requirements

* Resume / Curriculum Vitae

* LinkedIn Profile, if available

* Brief Summary of Relevant Experience

* Desired Monthly Compensation

* Weekly Availability

* Earliest Available Start Date

You'll be supporting the founder of an award-winning luxury travel and lifestyle media company based in Toronto, Canada. We're looking for a full-time, remote Executive Assistant & Sales / Marketing Coordinator to become the operational right hand to a busy founder. This is a hybrid role, part executive assistant, part sales and marketing support built for someone who's equal parts organized operator and proactive go-getter.



Your mission is to take the day-to-day admin, billing, and groundwork off the founder's plate so he can focus on what he does best: closing deals and growing the business. You'll own his inbox, calendar, and travel; keep billing (AP/AR) moving; build polished client proposals in Canva; research and build lead lists and keep the CRM clean; and grow the company's social media presence and partnerships across the travel community.

• Own this function with minimal guidance and bring a strategic, relationship-first mindset

Sales Support

• Research and build targeted lead lists for the founder's outreach

• CRM management —  Keep contacts, deals, and activity logged and up to date

• Track pipeline activity and surface warm leads to the founder

Client Proposals

• Build and customize professional client proposals in Canva

• Maintain proposal templates and tailor them to each client

• Ensure proposals are polished, on-brand, and delivered on time

Billing & Finance (AP/AR)

• Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable

• Send and follow up on invoices, track payments, and flag issues

• Keep billing organized and nothing falling through the cracks



Qualifications

Required:

• Strong written and verbal English — you'll draft
s, proposals, and outreach on behalf of the founder daily

• Proficiency with Canva for building professional, on-brand proposals and marketing assets

• Experience with AP/AR, invoicing, or general billing administration

• Experience managing someone else's inbox and calendar with discretion and good judgment

• Proven experience with lead research, list-building, and managing a CRM (logging contacts, deals, and activity)

• Hands-on social media management experience (posting, engagement, outreach — not just content creation)

• Proactive, self-directed mindset — you anticipate needs and take initiative without waiting to be asked

• Reliable internet connection and a dedicated, quiet workspace

Nice to Have:

• Experience building social media partnerships, influencer relationships, or brand collaborations

• Background in travel, media, or the agency space

• Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) and a willingness to work within an AI-first workflow 

• Experience supporting a founder across more than one business or venture

• Comfort with light bookkeeping or financial admin tools



Who Thrives in This Role

• You're equal parts organized operator and proactive go-getter — comfortable doing detailed admin and reaching out to start new relationships

• You take ownership — when something is in your lane, you run it without being micromanaged

• You communicate clearly and concisely — you summarize, you don't ramble

• You're a fast learner who picks up new tools, systems, and preferences quickly

• You're genuinely interested in using AI and automation to work smarter

• You're warm and relationship-driven — building partnerships and rapport energizes you



Work-From-Home Requirements

• Internet speed of at least 25 Mbps (upload & download)

• Noise-cancelling headset

• Power backup (UPS, generator, or nearby co-working space)

• Quiet, dedicated home workspace with a desk



Why Join Scaledforce

Benefits & Perks:

• HMO Health Insurance

• Paid Time Off + Sick Leave: 10 PTO days (accrued) + 5 sick days after probation

 the following to

Subject line: SFH Executive Assistant – [Your Name]

title: E-commerce Finance & Accounting Specialist
description:
## Summary



We are looking for a reliable and proactive finance employee to manage the day-to-day financial operations of our e-commerce businesses.



The role includes tracking invoices and payments, managing our accounts-payable Gmail inbox, maintaining QuickBooks, reconciling Wise, PayPal, banks and payment processors, tracking inventory, preparing financial reports, and potentially helping with cash-flow forecasting.



This is not a role for someone who only follows SOPs. We need someone who takes ownership, notices problems, investigates discrepancies, and reports unexpected issues promptly.



## Responsibilities



* Manage the accounts-payable Gmail inbox

* Track vendor and contractor invoices

* Organize invoices using Gmail labels

* Record invoice amounts, currencies, due dates and payment status

* Check for duplicate, incorrect or suspicious invoices

* Prepare payments through Wise, PayPal and bank accounts

* Track scheduled, completed, failed and overdue payments

* Maintain accurate records in QuickBooks

* Reconcile banks, credit cards, Wise, PayPal, Shopify and payment processors

* Track Shopify sales, refunds, chargebacks, fees and payouts

* Track payment-processor reserves, holds and delayed payouts

* Track inventory levels and stock movements

* Reconcile inventory records with Shopify, suppliers and warehouses

* Track purchase orders, supplier deposits and incoming inventory

* Maintain inventory valuation, COGS and landed-cost records

* Track advertising, shipping, fulfilment, software and processing expenses

* Prepare weekly and monthly financial reports

* Report unpaid invoices, upcoming payments and cash requirements

* Assist with cash-flow forecasting, budgeting and financial planning

* Keep financial documents organized for accountants and tax filings



## Reporting



You must promptly report unexpected issues such as:



* Missing or duplicate invoices

* Unusual charges

* Changes to vendor payment details

* Failed or delayed payments

* Missing payouts

* Reconciliation discrepancies

* Processor reserves or account holds

* Inventory shortages

* Unexpected increases in costs

* Suspicious transactions



Your report should explain what happened, the financial impact, what you investigated, and your recommended next step.



## Requirements



* Previous finance, bookkeeping or accounting experience

* E-commerce or DTC experience

* Strong QuickBooks knowledge

* Experience with Wise, PayPal, Shopify and online banking

* Strong spreadsheet skills

* Understanding of inventory, COGS and reconciliations

* Strong attention to detail

* High initiative and independent problem-solving ability

* Clear written English

* Reliable communication and follow-through

* Ability to handle sensitive financial information responsibly



## Security



You may prepare payments, but final payment approval will remain with management.



Any changes to vendor banking information must be independently verified before payment.



## To Apply



Please include:



1. A summary of your e-commerce finance or bookkeeping experience

2. The software and payment platforms you have used

3. Your experience with QuickBooks, inventory and reconciliations

4. An example of a financial discrepancy you identified and resolved

5. Your availability and expected hourly rate

6. Your MBTI type

title: Content Specialist
description:
About Fusion Vine

Fusion Vine is a remote-first company focused on building efficient, scalable systems that help businesses grow through smart operations, content, and digital execution. We specialize in combining human talent with AI-powered workflows to deliver high-quality results at scale.



Our team values clarity, accountability, continuous improvement, and performance-based growth. We work with clear processes, defined expectations, and a strong focus on outcomes.



Role Overview

Fusion Vine is hiring a Content Specialist to help scale content production through AI-assisted workflows. This role is ideal for motivated writers who can combine strong English skills with critical thinking and smart use of AI tools. Entry-level candidates are welcome: if you can think critically and move fast, we can work with you.



Key Goal

Produce high-quality, accurate, and well-structured content at speed: using AI as a tool, not a shortcut: while maintaining clarity, brand voice, and defined quality standards.



Responsibilities

Write and deliver content using AI models as a writing aid, not a replacement for judgment

Critically review and refine AI-generated drafts for readability, accuracy, tone, and structure

Fact-check content and ensure it meets quality standards before submission

Follow content briefs, SOPs, and style guidelines closely

Complete assigned article bundles within agreed timelines

Edit for grammar, readability, and proper formatting

Stay productive and proactive: do not wait to be pushed into tasks



Requirements

Strong English proficiency: written and reading comprehension

Ability to think critically and improve AI-generated content rather than copy it blindly

Self-motivated with a strong sense of urgency and follow-through

Reliable internet connection and a suitable work device

Ability to follow instructions, briefs, and feedback closely

Critical thinking and troubleshooting is essential

Comfortable using AI tools for content creation and editing

Entry-level candidates accepted: hustle and critical thinking matter more than years of experience



Nice to Have

Foundational knowledge or genuine interest in the topics being covered

Experience with SEO content writing

Familiarity with content management systems

Background in marketing, blogs, or long-form content

Prior experience working in a remote or freelance setting



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Speed of delivery: complete article bundles quickly and on schedule (e.g., 15 articles in 2 days, not 2 weeks)

Quality of output: submit polished, reviewed content that meets defined completion criteria

Critical thinking: demonstrate genuine review and refinement of AI outputs, not blind copy-paste

Responsiveness: jump into assigned projects immediately without delay

Consistency: maintain steady, reliable output throughout the trial period and beyond



Compensation

$3.50 – $5.00 per hour

Rate determined based on experience, skills, and performance during the trial period

Piecework/bundle-based structure: payment upon completion of each assigned bundle

One-month trial period to assess fit and performance

Opportunity to increase rate and expand hours after a successful trial



Why Join Fusion Vine?

Fully remote work environment

Clear systems, expectations, and feedback from day one

Performance-based growth: your results determine your opportunities

Hands-on experience with AI-powered content workflows

Opportunity for long-term partnership if the trial goes well

Entry-level friendly: we value drive and quality output over credentials

title: Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
Full-Time Digital Marketing Specialist - Google Ads, Meta, SEO (Shopify eCommerce)



About us

Waxit International is an Australian eCommerce and service business operating across multiple brands, including a fast-growing Shopify store. We've been in online retail for close to 15 years and know what good marketing looks like - we're now looking for the right person to help us do more of it.



The role

You'll help manage our paid ads (Meta + Google) and SEO across the business - primarily eCommerce, with campaigns also supporting our service lines. We want someone who genuinely loves performance marketing, thinks strategically, and brings ideas to the table rather than just executing tasks. This is a long-term, stable role with room to grow as the business grows.



What you'll be doing

- Build, launch, monitor, analyse and scale Google Ads campaigns (Search, Performance Max, AI Max, Shopping, Display)

- Build, monitor, analyse and scale Meta Ads 
 & Instagram) for both eCommerce and lead gen

- Manage and improve SEO - keyword research, on-page, technical, content briefs

- Set up and maintain tracking (Google suit of tracking, meta tracking, 3rd party tracking such as Triple Whale & more)

- Manage Shopify campaign integrations - product feeds, conversion tracking, app setup & more

- Report on performance honestly, and stay up to date with what's actively happening - what's working, what's not, what to try next, what's new, etc. 

- Stay across platform changes and emerging trends, and proactively suggest improvements

- Collaborate on creative briefs, landing page improvements, and CRO



Must have

- 3+ years hands-on experience running both Google Ads AND Meta Ads (not just one)

- Strong SEO foundation - technical and content

- Working knowledge of Shopify (apps, product feeds, conversion tracking, theme basics)

- Excellent written and spoken English - you'll be on calls with us regularly

- Strategic thinker, not just an executor

- Confident across GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, and Shopify analytics



Nice to have

- Triple Whale experience (attribution and analytics)

- Klaviyo or
 marketing experience

- CRO and landing page optimisation experience

- Experience with Australian, US, or UK market eCommerce brands



The details

- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Long-term, stable role with room to grow

- Some overlap with Australian business working hours preferred (2-4 hours per day)

- Pay: AUD $1,600–$2,600/month depending on experience



We're flexible on how we engage you, depending on what works best for you:

- Employer of Record option - full-time employment through a registered Philippine EOR, with all statutory benefits (13th month pay, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, paid leave)

- Independent contractor option - if you have an established freelance practice and prefer to invoice us directly, we're open to that. Paid via Easypay.

Let us know in your application which you'd prefer and why.



How to apply

Please complete the following:

- A short intro about you and why this role interests you

- 2–3 specific examples of campaigns you've run - include the platform, your role, what you did, and the results (numbers please, not fluff)

- Your monthly rate expectation in AUD

- Your preferred engagement structure (EOR or contractor)

- Start your application with the word "Mango" so we know you've actually read this ad

- We read every application personally and will respond to shortlisted candidates within a week.

title: DTC Creative Strategist — Fast-Scaling DTC Supplement Ecom Brand
description:
Hiring: Senior Direct Response Creative Strategist



JFM Ventures is the operator group behind a fast-scaling DTC supplement brand. We're doing multiple 7 figures a month and on pace for multiple 8 figures by the end of the year. That's just the starting line. Our vision is to build a multiple 9 figure household supplement brand that sits in the largest retailers in the nation, right alongside the biggest names in the category.



YOUR MISSION

Your mission is to create the winning ads that scale this brand. You'll crack new avatars and angles, turn them into concepts that convert on cold traffic, and then squeeze every winner for everything it's worth through relentless iteration. You own the creative engine, from research and angles to hooks, briefs, and the testing roadmap that d
 what we run next. You don't just pitch ideas, you own whether they win. The best people here care more about what converts than what looks good in a portfolio.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Crack new winning avatars, angles, and hooks across our core formats like native statics, video scripts, VSL, AI, and UGC

- Build iterations off every winner to scale it as far as it will go before it fatigues

- Mine voice-of-customer insight (reviews, Reddit, comments, competitor ads) and turn it into angles people actually respond to

- Write sharp briefs and scripts your editors and designers can execute against without guesswork

- Own the testing roadmap, d
 what gets tested, reading the performance data in the ad account, and calling the winner

- Maintain a living angle and hook library so the team always has the next test queued

- Diagnose losers fast and turn the insight into the next concept to run

- Apply direct response fundamentals to everything, because you understand what makes people buy

- Operate with high autonomy, managing your testing cadence and pipeline without hand-holding

- As a foundational tea
mber, help set our creative standards and onboard future strategists as we scale



OUR TECH STACK

- Data & Attribution. Triple Whale, Meta Ads Manager

- Briefs & Project Management. Google Drive, ClickUp

- AI Avatar & Generation. HeyGen, Google Flow, Hedra

- Voiceover. ElevenLabs

- Image Generation. Midjourney, Krea

- Communication. Slack



KPIs YOU WILL OWN

Your KPIs and output targets depend on the format you specialize in (native statics, video scripts, VSL, AI, UGC), but across the board you own:

- Hit Rate. A strong and rising percentage of your concepts becoming winners

- Output. A steady volume of net-new tested angles and iterations every week, scaled to your format

- Performance. ROAS and CPA on the creative you direct, and how much profitable spend your winners can hold as we scale



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Proven direct response creative strategy experience at a brand doing $10M+ per year. Non-negotiable

- A portfolio of ads with real performance behind them, including winning concepts, hit rate, and total spend your creatives have run on Meta

- Deep command of DR fundamentals like avatars, mechanisms, hooks, pacing, retention, and what drives conversions

- Sharp at voice-of-customer research and translating raw insight into testable angles

- Data-driven, able to read ad account performance and turn it into better creative decisions

- Strong copywriting instincts and the ability to brief editors and UGC creators clearly

- Experience in health, wellness, or supplements is a strong plus

High autonomy operator who runs their own testing cycles without being managed

- Strong written English for briefs, scripts, and communication

- Genuinely obsessed with creative performance, not just creative craft



WHY JOIN JFM VENTURES

- Aggressive ad spend % performance bonus. When your creative scales profitable spend, you get paid for it

- High impact work. Your angles run on real spend and reach real buyers every single day

- Direct line to founders and the creative team, with no layers and no politics

- Early tea
mber advantage. Top performers will be given opportunities to lead and grow

- Fully remote. We measure output, not hours

- Fast-moving environment. Multiple 7 figures a month and climbing, the pace is real



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

- You need constant direction to stay productive

- You look to competitors for every idea instead of doing your own research

- You think like a traditional art director, disconnected from paid social data

- You're uncomfortable with tools, formats, and angles changing fast. Our environment shifts and you have to move with it

- You don't have real direct response experience. Brand and social content is not the same thing

- You see this as a freelance side project. This is full-time and we need full commitment

- Paid media and DR marketing doesn't genuinely excite you. If it's just a job, this isn't the right fit



HOW TO APPLY

If you live and breathe direct response and you can prove your ads have moved real money, we want to hear from you.



At the top of your application, list a few of the top brands you've worked with, then walk us through the single best ad you've made, the results it drove, and the psychology behind why it worked.



Fill out the full application below. We review every application personally and if there's a fit, we'll be in touch shortly. Looking forward to speaking soon!
