title: Amazon Product Sourcing & Research | China Negotiation | 3+ Years PL Experience
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands - one in the travel accessories category and one in beauty devices - with 52+ active SKUs.



We're not a startup figuring things out - we have systems, a team, and a clear direction. What we need now is someone senior who can take full ownership of product development for one of our brands while we scale.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is a specialist position for someone who has done this before and can work independently.

You will own the full product lifecycle for one brand: from identifying opportunities, to negotiating with Chinese suppliers on WeChat, to making sure samples, timelines, packaging, and user manuals are all on track before launch. You'll also do product research for our second brand.

You'll work closely with our marketing and design team, and report directly to the owner.



What You'll Do Daily:

- Conduct product research across Amazon marketplaces (US/CA/UK/EU/AU/JP)

- Analyze competition, demand, pricing, and profitability (ROI, FBA fees, net margin)

- Communicate directly with Chinese suppliers via WeChat - negotiate pricing, MOQs, timelines

- Request and evaluate samples, coordinate quality checks

- Monitor production timelines and flag delays before they become problems

- Review packaging and user manuals for compliance (not copy, just accuracy)

- Calculate profitability at every stage before committing to a launch

- Collaborate with marketing and graphic design teams on launch prep

- Report weekly with recommendations and progress updates



Tools You Must Know:

- Helium 10 (Cerebro, Black Box, Xray, Keyword Tracker)

- Keepa - price history, trends, seasonality

- Amazon Seller Central - BSR, sales data interpretation

- Alibaba + WeChat - supplier sourcing and negotiation

- Google Sheets / Excel - ROI models, dashboards, profitability trackers

- Jungle Scout - a plus



Who We're Looking For:

- 3–5 years experience in Amazon Private Label product development and sourcing

- You've negotiated directly with Chinese suppliers - not just browsed Alibaba

- You think in numbers: margins, costs, lead times, risks

- You communicate clearly in English, written and verbal

- You're organized and proactive - you chase timelines, you don't wait to be chased

- You want a long-term role with room to grow, not a short contract



Compensation & Setup:

- $1,000–$1,400/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week

- 14 days paid leave after 3 months

- First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor (removed after we establish trust)

- Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



Important

This role is for one of our brands that currently has no team. You'll be building from the ground up with clear direction from ownership. If you need someone to micromanage your daily tasks, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and autonomy, keep reading.





To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. Applications without answers will not be considered:



1. Describe a product you sourced from a Chinese supplier, how did you find them, how did you negotiate, and what was the final outcome? Include the platform you used to find them (Alibaba, WeChat, trade show etc.), the MOQ you negotiated, and one specific thing that almost went wrong. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you actually did.

2. Walk me through your evaluation process for a Private Label product - what metrics matter most to you, what makes you say no, and what makes you say yes? Give a real example without naming the product. What's your process, not your tools.

3. What tools do you use daily for Amazon product research, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - walk me through one specific thing you do in it that most people skip or don't know about.

4. What's the biggest mistake you've seen (or made) in product development, and what did you change after? Be specific.

title: Outbound Cold Caller — $1,200/month + $50 per show-up appointment
description:
Why experienced setters join us



We created a role where your effort and results directly impact what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that is serious about helping you grow.



If you’re experienced, consistent, and take your work seriously, this is a place where you can build something long-term.



01 — Uncapped earning potential



Your income grows with your performance. The compensation structure is clear, the targets are realistic, and there is no limit to what you can earn each month.



02 — Leadership that helps you improve



You’ll work closely with a team that understands this business and knows what works. We share proven strategies, coach you on what needs improvement, and help you sharpen your skills — including tone, objection handling, and conversation flow.



03 — A supportive, high-performing team



We hold a high standard, but we also support each other in reaching it. You’ll be surrounded by people who are serious about their work, their performance, and their growth.



Compensation — paid weekly via Wise



Base salary: $1,200 USD/month — guaranteed

Per qualified appointment: $50 USD — paid on top of base

Status bonus: 10–20% of closed deals the following month



The status bonus — how it works



Set 12+ qualified appointments in a month and you unlock a percentage of every deal that closes the following month — regardless of when you originally set those leads.



Hit 12 appointments = 10%

Hit 16 appointments = 15%

Hit 20 appointments = 20%



The more consistent you are, the more it compounds. At Bronze level, that’s an additional ~$375/month. At Gold level, that can be an additional ~$1,250/month — all on top of your base salary and per-appointment pay.



Working hours



9:00am – 5:30pm Eastern Time (ET)

That is 10:00pm – 6:30am Philippine Time (PHT).



This is a night shift role, and we want to be fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that’s you, and you’re comfortable with the schedule, the compensation reflects the commitment.



Onboarding



Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We’ll walk you through the script, CRM, process, and call flow until you feel confident.



To join the core team, the target during onboarding is a minimum of 3 qualified appointments. This is a realistic and achievable goal, and we’ll be coaching you throughout the process to help you get there.



What you’ll actually do



Make 150–200 outbound cold calls per day to businesses that may need commercial janitorial services.



Identify real needs and book qualified appointments with businesses that are ready to receive a cleaning quote.



Deliver a proven script in a natural and conversational way — not robotic or mechanical.



Keep your pipeline, notes, and call logs updated accurately in the CRM each day.



Receive ongoing coaching and access to strategies that have already proven to work.

description:
Resource Manager / Recruitment Specialist (Remote, Part-Time)



Role Snapshot

We're a labour hire and workforce solutions business operating across WA, NSW, and VIC — placing skilled workers across landscaping, forestry, construction, mining, horticulture, and civil industries. This role sits at the operational core of what we do: keeping payroll accurate, compliance tight, and resourcing moving. We're looking for a replacement hire to step into an established role with clear systems, a functioning team, and high standards — and raise the bar.



Hours & Setup



Type: Part-time, remote

Schedule: Monday to Friday (exact hours to be confirmed at onboarding)

Time zone: Aligned to Western Australian business hours (AWST)

Location: Work from home

Environment: Virtual online office — live video connection maintained throughout the working day is a part of this role

Seasonal flex: Hours increase during peak planting/forestry seasons — overtime applies





What You'll Be Doing

Payroll Data Entry & Compliance (Daily Priority)



Cross-check timesheets signed off by site supervisors against the master sheet each morning — verify hours and units are correct before they reach payroll

Cross-reference the scheduling software as a third data point to catch discrepancies not visible in the first two sources

Log into Deputy twice daily to verify employee check-in and check-out times; resolve any attendance discrepancies

Input approved timesheet data (via Tray Sheets) into Xero for bi-weekly payroll processing

Mark tasks as complete in the tracking system to maintain clear status visibility at all times



Scheduling & Resource Coordination



Liaise daily with project coordinators and site supervisors to understand upcoming resourcing needs

Finalise and publish next-day schedules by 4:30 PM each day, following the 3:30 PM supervisor check-in call

Remain available throughout the day to respond to resource shortages, equipment needs, or last-minute scheduling changes

Arrange accommodation for field staff on remote projects within budget parameters and company standards



Recruitment & HR Coordination



Advertise vacancies for casual and short-term positions across relevant job boards

Screen applicants, conduct reference checks, verify qualifications, and manage candidate pipelines to align with project timelines

Coordinate onboarding for new hires: induction scheduling, compliance training, and ensuring all site access requirements are met before workers arrive

Conduct VEVO (visa eligibility verification) checks on all new hires and repeat every three months — maintain compliance records accurately in 

Handle employee queries and escalate disputes where appropriate

Conduct performance reviews every four months and keep employee records up to date



Reporting & Administration



Participate in weekly Management Meetings (Fridays at 2:30 PM AWST)

Prepare monthly staffing and resource allocation reports for the management team

Collect and upload site-specific Safety Reports to 
 by the 25th of each month

Maintain and update employee data in 
 as the workforce changes

Send daily start-of-day priorities and an end-of-day task summary via ConnectTeam



Daily Communication & Online Office



Participate in the virtual online office — video connection maintained throughout the working day

Communicate availability transparently: log your schedule in the company system and keep it current without being prompted; flexible hours are fine, invisible hours are not

Raise questions in real time rather than allowing uncertainty to produce errors downstream

Use Timely (AI time tracker) to log and summarise daily activity accurately





What We're Looking For

Experience



Previous experience in HR coordination, resource management, or recruitment administration — essential

Demonstrable experience with payroll data entry, preferably using Deputy and/or Xero

Experience recruiting for high-volume, casual workforces is a significant advantage

Background in environmental, agricultural, construction, or field operations industries preferred — strong fast learners considered

Bookkeeping or accounting background is a strong plus: this role demands genuine confidence with numbers, pattern recognition across data sets, and zero tolerance for payroll errors



Technical Skills



Deputy — primary scheduling and attendance platform; mandatory proficiency

Xero — payroll input and financial management; strong proficiency required


 — project and employee management; prior use preferred, training available

ConnectTeam — HR platform for daily task reporting and clock-in/out

Timely — AI activity tracker for daily time logging

Slack — daily internal coordination

Dialpad — phone calls with site supervisors

VEVO Portal — visa eligibility verification; training provided if needed

Microsoft Office / Google Suite — document management and reporting



Communication & Work Style



Strong written and verbal English — you'll liaise with supervisors, candidates, and management daily

Proactive communicator: raises questions as they arise, does not sit on uncertainty

Reliable about availability: logs in and out clearly and communicates schedule changes without being asked

Comfortable in a virtual online office — active participant, not a reluctant observer

Confident working independently through a task list and escalating when something doesn't look right





You'll Thrive Here If You Are…

Numbers-confident — Genuinely at ease working with data, payroll figures, and cross-referenced spreadsheets all day. This is not a role for someone who tolerates numbers; it's for someone who is comfortable making them their core daily output.

Accountable by default — When something goes wrong, your first instinct is to understand why and prevent it from happening again — not to deflect, minimise, or repeat the same mistake.

Proactively autonomous — You don't wait to be prompted. You move through the task list, communicate progress, and flag issues before they become problems.

Composed under pressure — Peak season gets intense, but the pressure is manageable when you stay ahead of the work. You chase inputs early, cross-check on the day things are due, and keep work moving so the crunch never compounds.

Detail-obsessed — You catch the small things — the mismatched hour, the missing induction record, the VEVO check coming due. Routine accuracy is never treated as a low priority.

A reliable communicator — The team always knows when you're in. You log on when you start, communicate breaks or unavailability, and respond within a reasonable timeframe. Transparent availability is the baseline, not a bonus.

An initiative-taker — You see what's coming, prepare for it, and surface things the team doesn't yet know they need to know. You create tasks, not just tick them.

Escalate urgent issues, missed shifts, complaints or service risks to management

Maintain professional communication with staff, clients and internal teams

Maintain accurate records of shifts, staff availability and service changes



Assist with tracking staff documents, training, qualifications and compliance requirements



Support incident, cancellation and shift note follow-ups where required



Assist with timesheet checks and roster accuracy before payroll or invoicing



Help maintain clean and organised client and staff records



### Systems & Reporting



Use rostering, CRM, spreadsheet or care management systems to manage information



Prepare simple reports on roster gaps, staff availability, unfilled shifts or service issues



Keep trackers updated and accurate



Identify process improvements to make rostering more efficient



Support management with general operations tasks as required



## What We Are Looking For



Strong written and verbal English communication



Experience in rostering, scheduling, workforce coordination, healthcare administration or virtual assistance



Highly organised and detail-focused



Able to work quickly and calmly when roster changes occur

Comfortable using spreadsheets,
, online systems and shared folders

Trustworthy with confidential client and staff information



## Preferred Experience



Previous experience in NDIS, disability support, aged care, healthcare or home care rostering

Experience working with Australian businesses or clients

title: Brand and Creative Designer
description:
Brand and Creative Designer (Full Time)



Location: Fully Remote (Must be responsive during Singapore business hours)



Employment Type: Full Time



Portfolio Requirement: Applicants must submit a portfolio demonstrating strong capabilities in layout design, typography, branding, and print collateral.



About Brawn & Brains Coffee



Brawn & Brains Coffee is a Singapore-based specialty coffee roaster, café operator, and hospitality brand. Beyond serving coffee, we build communities through thoughtfully designed spaces, events, partnerships, and experiences.



We believe great design is purposeful, clear, and timeless. As we continue to grow our cafés, wholesale business, and community initiatives, we are looking for a talented Remote Graphic Designer to help bring our ideas and brand vision to life.



The Role



We are seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Brand and Creative Designer with a strong eye for layout, typography, and visual storytelling.



Working remotely, you will collaborate closely with our operations and marketing teams to develop compelling visual assets across both digital and print platforms. The ideal candidate understands how to communicate information clearly while maintaining a premium, modern aesthetic.



Key Responsibilities

Marketing & Promotional Materials

Design posters, flyers, social media graphics, and promotional assets for product launches, seasonal campaigns, workshops, and community events.

Create compelling visuals that drive customer engagement while remaining aligned with our brand identity.

Menu & Retail Design

Design and update menus, table-top displays, counter signage, food labels, and other in-store communication materials.

Ensure information is clear, visually balanced, and customer-friendly.

Wholesale & Corporate Collateral

Design wholesale catalogues, proposal decks, presentation materials, price lists, product sheets, and corporate marketing assets.

Translate complex information into clean, professional, and visually appealing layouts.

Brand Consistency

Maintain consistency across all brand touchpoints, ensuring typography, colour palettes, imagery, and design standards remain cohesive.

Assist in developing templates and design systems that support long-term brand growth.

Who We're Looking For

Strong Design Fundamentals



You have a deep appreciation for typography, spacing, hierarchy, and composition. You understand that effective design is often about clarity, restraint, and attention to detail.



Independent & Accountable



You are comfortable working remotely, managing multiple projects, meeting deadlines, and communicating proactively without constant supervision.



Creative Problem Solver



You can take a brief, understand the objective, and translate it into a polished design solution that feels intentional and commercially effective.



Technical Proficiency



You are proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop) and/or Canva at an advanced professional level.



Preferred Experience

Hospitality, F&B, lifestyle, retail, or consumer brand experience

Experience designing for both print and digital platforms

Familiarity with preparing artwork for commercial printing

Understanding of social media content formats and marketing communications

How to Apply



Please send the following to 



Resume / CV

Portfolio link or design samples





Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.



What We Offer

Flexible Remote Working



Work from anywhere while maintaining alignment with project timelines and communication requirements.



Meaningful Creative Work



Contribute to a growing specialty coffee and hospitality brand with diverse projects spanning cafés, wholesale, events, retail, and community initiatives.



Long-Term Career Opportunities



We value long-term partnerships and are looking for designers who can grow with the brand as we continue to expand.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
## Role



We’re hiring a Social Media Manager to own the strategy, coordination, and execution of social media distribution for some of the fastest-growing podcast brands on the internet. 



You will manage end-to-end social media execution across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram,
, X, and LinkedIn, turning podcast episodes into high-performing content that drives millions of views.



You’ll work directly with high-profile entrepreneurs and founders who are building movements, not just audiences. You’ll collaborate closely with a world-class creative team and take real ownership of growth outcomes across multiple high-stakes brands. 



This role is ideal for someone who deeply understands social media, thinks in hooks and distribution, moves fast, and gets energy fro
asurable results.



## What You Own



You own the distribution, positioning, and performance of content once it is ready to publish. That means d
 what gets posted, how it is positioned, when it goes live, how it performs, and what to optimise next. You are accountable for outcomes, not production.



## Role Clarity (Important)



This is not an editing or graphic design role. You will not be editing videos or designing thumbnails. Your responsibility is to ensure content is ready to publish. This means being able to quickly spot spelling or factual errors, incorrect branding or tone, and visuals, thumbnails, or covers that are clearly off-standard. You are not responsible for detailed video QA, edit notes, or design iterations. Editors and designers own production quality.



## Responsibilities

Captioning & Hooks (AI-Assisted): Write click-worthy captions, hooks, and titles using AI and strategic thinking

Content Readiness Checks: Before publishing, confirm content is accurate, on-brand, and free from obvious errors.

Publishing & Scheduling: Upload, schedule, and publish content across YouTube, TikTok, Meta (FB & IG), X, and LinkedIn with zero mistakes.

Creative Awareness: Ensure YouTube thumbnails, IG covers, and episode graphics meet brand standards and are suitable for publishing.

Client Communication: Manage daily communication, approvals, and feedback with clients clearly and professionally.

Content & Trend Research: Track viral trends, analyse competitors, and pitch fresh content ideas weekly.

Performance Tracking: Monitor performance using Metricool and reporting tools to identify wins and optimisation opportunities.

Systems & Ops Support: Maintain clean 
 structures, update weekly distribution schedules, and keep workflows organised.



## Requirements

2+ years managing social media professionally with proven growth results.

Strong understanding of short-form and long-form content performance.

Strategic awareness of editing and design principles (hooks, pacing, thumbnails) without doing the work.

Experience with or familiarity in YouTube, TikTok, Instagram,
, X, LinkedIn, Canva (review and light adjustments only), ChatGPT or similar AI tools, Metricool or similar scheduling platforms.

Highly desired: 
, 
, podcast hosting platforms, transcription tools.

Data-driven mindset with attention to detail.

Native-level written English.

Reliable internet connection.

Available 8AM–5PM AEST.



## Results You’re Accountable For



Maintain a minimum 4% YouTube CTR.

100% on-time, error-free publishing.

Launch at least one successful new content format or growth experiment per client per quarter.

Maintain 95%+ client satisfaction.

Deliver weekly content ideas aligned with strategy and trends.

Produce monthly performance insights with clear next steps.

Maintain clean, predictable content systems.



## Compensation



Base Rate: $8–$10 AUD per hour, based on experience and results.



Performance Bonuses

Monthly Views Bonus

Viral Content Bonus

Quarterly Performance Bonus

Quarterly Innovation Bonus

World-Class Training: Access to elite marketing education and weekly growth sessions.



## Working With Us



We move fast, hold high standards, and expect ownership. This is not a passive role. You are trusted to think, d
, and execute. If you want comfort and predictability, this isn’t it. If you want growth, responsibility, and real impact, you’ll thrive here.

We need a second technical scriptwriter to join our team.



This is not a content writing job. This is not blog posts or social media copy. This is technical, step-by-step instructional scripting for screen-recorded software tutorials — and it requires someone who can actually use these tools, understand how they work at a deep level, and translate that into clear, precise, engaging narration.



Think: "Click the plus icon in the upper-right corner of your List view. A dropdown will appear with over 30 field types. We're going to focus on five of them..." — that level of specificity.



**What you'll be doing:**

- Writing complete 5,000–15,000 word scripts for long-form tutorial videos (1–3 hours when recorded)

- Researching and using ClickUp, Notion, and 
 hands-on before writing — you need to actually go into the tool and figure it out

- Structuring tutorials chapter by chapter with clear progressions, real use-case examples, and step-by-step UI navigation instructions

- Revising based on feedback from our host/producer until the script is tight and ready to record

- Keeping up with product updates — these tools change constantly, and scripts need to reflect current UI and features



**What we're looking for:**

- Excellent written English — native-level clarity, grammar, and flow. University-educated, ideally with a degree that required significant English writing

- Genuine interest in SaaS tools, productivity software, and how teams work — not faked enthusiasm, actual curiosity

- Ability to learn software fast. You don't need to know ClickUp inside and out right now — but you need to be the type of person who opens a new tool and figures it out systematically

- Strong logical structure — tutorials need to flow in the right order. You need to think like a teacher

- Attention to detail at the UI level — "click the horizontal ellipsis" not "click the menu"

- Reliability and the ability to meet deadlines without hand-holding



**What we don't want:**

- Generalist writers who "can adapt to anything" — this role requires real technical depth

- Anyone who will rely on AI to do the research and writing — you can use AI as a tool, but the thinking and the tool-exploration has to be yours

- Someone who has never used project management software



**How to apply:**



Do NOT just send your CV. Applications without a writing sample will be ignored.



Please send:

1. A short (3–5 sentence) introduction — tell us who you are, your educational background, and why this role fits you

2. A writing sample: either an existing piece of technical/instructional writing you've done, OR a short original sample (500–1,000 words) of a step-by-step tutorial script for any SaaS tool you know well — written in the style described above

3. Your availability and expected monthly rate



We will send shortlisted candidates a paid test task before making any hiring decision.



SKILLS: Technical Writing, Instructional Design, SaaS / Software Documentation
